Checkout and capture procedure (2026-08-29):

1. git clone --shared --no-checkout C:/src/pelican2 .wp354-parent-capture
2. git -C .wp354-parent-capture checkout --detach b9a1eed14043573d52d8f045a36fa1006c123f37
3. Add only the CPU construction seam used by WP354a to the parent Renderer:
   Renderer(RendererFramePlanCpuSeam, RenderingPassId). It initializes the
   selected pass id and bypasses startup/GPU construction; it does not change
   currentFramePlanJson() or any serializer.
4. Publish the 15-node wp354_family_contract through
   FrameGraphRuntimeContainer::registerExecutionPlan with a real non-null
   CompiledRenderPipeline, then call Renderer::currentFramePlanJson().
5. Write plan.dump(2) plus one newline and run the capture Catch test.

Capture result:

  1/1 Test #1: capture the e867099 parent renderer frame plan ... Passed
  100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 1

The parent output has no profile field and no node has shader_resolution.
WP374 intentionally overlays only the additive diagnostic defaults
/ray_query_acceleration_structures/blas_variant_count = 0 and
/ray_query_acceleration_structures/resident_blas_keys = []; the original
capture hash and size above remain the provenance for every other field. The
checked-in JSON is never regenerated by the test. The current test invokes the
same Renderer::currentFramePlanJson() CPU seam, requires every node's new
field, removes only /profile and /nodes/<index>/shader_resolution, and requires
nlohmann::json::diff(the explicit baseline, stripped) to contain zero
operations. No WP374 pointer is added to the permitted removal list, so any
further projection growth still trips this recursive comparison.
